keySentence: She floated down the river on a lily leaf.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: She went down the river. It was getting cold. She held on tight. She floated down the river on a lily leaf.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The stream carried Thumbelina further and further from home. She floated down the river on a lily leaf all day. Beautiful flowers and tall trees passed by on both sides. As the sun set, the air became cold and dark. Thumbelina held onto the leaf and refused to give up. She was tiny but her courage was bigger than her size.
